Overview

Dera Ghazi Khan is a city in Punjab with a population of 500,000. A historic city in southern Punjab at the foot of the Sulaiman Mountains, known for its tribal culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
